en:
Hmph...I never thought I'd ever feel 
like this again, but...

It was fun hanging out 
with you, Shuichi.
Well, I guess we should head back.

Geez... Being around you 
eases my heart a bit.

If you want, I'd like it if 
you invited me again.
I guess I'll head back to the dorms.

I thought you'd be able to change 
me...I guess I was mistaken.

Me and you, we've still got 
a long ways to go...
